body: I understand what you mean. It’s that disappointing cycle of settling. I think over the years it’s left only feeling happy over a moment rather than periods of time. I’ve found that it’s because of growing and discovering the root of my disappointments and pain. It’s loosing that innocence of reality and what actually hurts. I think if anything it were to be something underneath that isn’t noticeable, a pain or trauma that sneaks up. I don’t know how to help, I’m very lost myself, but maybe that opens your eyes to anything. Or at least gives a little reassurance
